headline: Anthropic merges Cowork into Claude and adds document tools
summary: Four outlets report Anthropic folding Cowork into the Claude chat interface and adding tools for creating documents and presentations. Two of the four texts say the features reach Pro and Max subscribers first; the others describe what is being added without saying who gets it.
